name: Gdn2Fwd

g.description: log 域逐通道衰减 [B, T, H, K] fp32 (恒 <= 0)

initial_state.description: 初始状态 [N, H, K, V] fp32, 首维 0 表示无

cu_seqlens.description: varlen 前缀和 [N+1] int32 (B=1), 可选

use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel.description: kernel 内是否做 q/k L2 归一化 (0/1)

o.description: 输出 [B, T, H, V], dtype 与 v 一致

final_state.description: 最终状态 [N, H, K, V] fp32

reference:
import zlib

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F


def _segment_fwd(q, k, v, g, b, w, S, scale):
    # q,k,g,b [X,T,H,K]; v,w [X,T,H,V]; S [X,H,K,V] (fp32)
    device = q.device
    T = q.shape[1]
    V = v.shape[-1]
    o = torch.empty(q.shape[0], T, q.shape[2], V, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    for t in range(T):
        S = S * g[:, t].exp().unsqueeze(-1)
        erase = ((b[:, t] * k[:, t]).unsqueeze(-1) * S).sum(-2)
        v_new = w[:, t] * v[:, t] - erase
        S = S + k[:, t].unsqueeze(-1) * v_new.unsqueeze(-2)
        o[:, t] = ((scale * q[:, t]).unsqueeze(-1) * S).sum(-2)
    return o, S


def run(q, k, v, g, b, w, initial_state, cu_seqlens=None, scale=None,
        use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=1):
    """GDN-2 (Gated DeltaNet 2) chunkwise 前向 golden (逐 token 精确递推)。

    数学定义 (矩阵状态 S ∈ R^{KxV}, * 为逐通道 Hadamard 积):
        S_t = (I - k_t (b_t k_t)^T) Diag(exp(g_t)) S_{t-1} + k_t (w_t v_t)^T
        o_t = (scale * q_t)^T S_t    (读出发生在写入之后)
    b = w = beta (标量) 时退化为 KDA; g 再退化为标量时为 GDN v1。

    布局: q,k,g,b [B,T,H,K]; v,w [B,T,H,V]; initial_state [N,H,K,V] fp32
    (首维 0 表示无初始状态); cu_seqlens [N+1] int32 可选 (varlen, B=1)。
    输出 o [B,T,H,V] (v.dtype), final_state [N,H,K,V] fp32。
    """
    device = q.device
    B, T, H, K = q.shape
    V = v.shape[-1]
    qf, kf = q.float(), k.float()
    if use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel:
        # fla l2norm: y = x * rsqrt(sum(x^2) + 1e-6)
        qf = qf * torch.rsqrt((qf * qf).sum(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
        kf = kf * torch.rsqrt((kf * kf).sum(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
    vf, gf, bf, wf = v.float(), g.float(), b.float(), w.float()

    has_init = initial_state is not None and initial_state.shape[0] > 0
    if cu_seqlens is not None and len(cu_seqlens) > 0:
        assert B == 1, "varlen 要求 B=1"
        N = len(cu_seqlens) - 1
        o = torch.empty(1, T, H, V, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
        final = torch.empty(N, H, K, V, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
        for n in range(N):
            s, e = int(cu_seqlens[n]), int(cu_seqlens[n + 1])
            S0 = (initial_state[n:n + 1].float() if has_init
                  else torch.zeros(1, H, K, V, device=device))
            o_n, S_n = _segment_fwd(
                qf[:, s:e], kf[:, s:e], vf[:, s:e],
                gf[:, s:e], bf[:, s:e], wf[:, s:e], S0, scale)
            o[:, s:e] = o_n
            final[n] = S_n[0]
    else:
        N = B
        S0 = initial_state.float() if has_init else torch.zeros(B, H, K, V, device=device)
        o, S_n = _segment_fwd(qf, kf, vf, gf, bf, wf, S0, scale)
        final = S_n
    return o.to(v.dtype), final


_DTYPE_CODE = {0: torch.float16, 1: torch.bfloat16, 2: torch.float32}


def make_inputs(axes, device):
    """Custom input generator (custom_inputs_entrypoint).

    Deterministic per case: RNG is reseeded from the axes dict so repeated
    calls (once per custom input) produce identical tensors. Tensors are
    generated on CPU; the evaluator moves them to the target device.
    Scalars (scale / use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel) are returned as plain Python
    values (workloads may not mix custom and non-custom inputs).

    axes:
        B, T, H, K, V   q/k/g/b [B,T,H,K], v/w [B,T,H,V]
        DT      dtype code for q/k/v/b/w (0=fp16, 1=bf16, 2=fp32); g fp32
        NSTATE  initial_state 行数 (0 = 无初始状态); fp32 [NSTATE,H,K,V]
        NV      varlen 序列数 (0 = 等长 batch); NV>0 时需 CU_0..CU_NV, B=1
        SCALE_U scale * 1e6 as int
        USE_L2  use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel (0/1)
    """
    torch.manual_seed(zlib.crc32(repr(sorted(axes.items())).encode()) & 0x7FFFFFFF)
    B, T, H, K, V = axes["B"], axes["T"], axes["H"], axes["K"], axes["V"]
    dt = _DTYPE_CODE[axes["DT"]]
    use_l2 = axes["USE_L2"]
    nv = axes["NV"]

    def random_tensor(shape, dtype):
        # 标准输入分布: 50% 均匀 [-5, 5] + 50% 正态 (mu ∈ [-5, 5], sigma ∈ [0.1, 2])
        if torch.rand(1).item() < 0.5:
            return torch.empty(shape, dtype=dtype).uniform_(-5.0, 5.0)
        mu = float(torch.empty(1).uniform_(-5.0, 5.0).item())
        sigma = float(torch.empty(1).uniform_(0.1, 2.0).item())
        return torch.normal(mu, sigma, shape, dtype=dtype)

    q = random_tensor([B, T, H, K], dt)
    k = random_tensor([B, T, H, K], dt)
    v = random_tensor([B, T, H, V], dt)
    # 物理约束: use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=0 时上游必须先对 q/k 做 L2 归一化,
    # 否则 delta rule 的 (I - k*(b*k)^T) 在 ||k|| 大时特征值越界发散
    if not use_l2:
        q = F.normalize(q.float(), p=2, dim=-1).to(dt)
        k = F.normalize(k.float(), p=2, dim=-1).to(dt)
    # 物理约束: g 是 log 域逐通道衰减, 恒 <= 0 (uniform(-5, -0.1))
    g = torch.empty([B, T, H, K], dtype=torch.float32).uniform_(-5.0, -0.1)
    # 物理约束: b (擦除门) 与 w (写入门) 是 sigmoid 类门控, 恒在 (0, 1)
    b = torch.rand([B, T, H, K], dtype=dt)
    w = torch.rand([B, T, H, V], dtype=dt)
    if axes["NSTATE"] == 0:
        initial_state = torch.zeros(0, H, K, V, dtype=torch.float32)
    else:
        initial_state = random_tensor([axes["NSTATE"], H, K, V], torch.float32)

    out = {"q": q, "k": k, "v": v, "g": g, "b": b, "w": w,
           "initial_state": initial_state,
           "scale": axes["SCALE_U"] / 1e6,
           "use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel": use_l2}
    if nv > 0:
        out["cu_seqlens"] = torch.tensor([axes[f"CU_{i}"] for i in range(nv + 1)],
                                         dtype=torch.int32)
    return out
description: GDN-2 (Gated DeltaNet 2) chunkwise forward golden, aligned with fla-org/flash-linear-attention chunk_gdn2 (math per fla/ops/gdn2/naive.py). Exact per-token recurrence in fp32: S <- S * exp(g_t); erase = (b_t k_t)^T S; v_new = w_t v_t - erase; S <- S + k_t outer v_new; o_t = (scale q_t)^T S. b = w = beta degenerates to KDA. use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=1 applies fla l2norm (x * rsqrt(sum(x^2)+1e-6)) first. state_v_first=False fixed; use_gate_in_kernel is out of scope (see FusedGdnGating). Inputs are generated by make_inputs (custom_inputs_entrypoint): q/k/v standard mixed (pre-normalized when USE_L2=0), g = uniform(-5, -0.1), b/w = rand, initial_state standard mixed fp32 or empty.
